name: Harbour Centre Development Limited
summary: Harbour Centre Development Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the hotel ownership, and property investment and development activities in Hong Kong, Mainland China, and internationally. The company operates through Hotels; Investment properties; Development properties; Investments; and Others segments. It engages in the acquisition, development, and sale of trading properties, as well as invests in and leases properties. The company operates The Murray hotel, Marco Polo Hongkong Hotel, Marco Polo Changzhou hotel, and Niccolo Suzhou.
